#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool="$base/spool"
delivered="$base/delivered"
quarantine="$base/quarantine"
index="$delivered/index.tsv"

mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"
if [ ! -f "$index" ]; then
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index"
fi

message_id_from_file() {
    awk '
        BEGIN { count = 0; value = "" }
        {
            sub(/\r$/, "", $0)
            if ($0 == "") exit
            line = $0
            if (tolower(line) ~ /^message-id:[[:space:]]*/) {
                count++
                sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, "", line)
                sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", line)
                value = line
            }
        }
        END {
            if (count == 1 && value ~ /^<[^<>[:space:]]+>$/) print value
        }
    ' "$1"
}

index_has_id() {
    awk -F '\t' -v wanted="$1" '
        NR > 1 && $1 == wanted { found = 1 }
        END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }
    ' "$index"
}

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -f "$message" ] || continue
    name=${message##*/}
    message_id=$(message_id_from_file "$message")

    if [ -z "$message_id" ]; then
        cp "$message" "$quarantine/$name"
        printf 'Rejected %s: missing, repeated, or invalid Message-ID header. Original retained at %s.\n' \
            "$name" "$message" > "$quarantine/$name.reason"
        printf 'QUARANTINED\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" 'invalid Message-ID'
        continue
    fi

    if index_has_id "$message_id"; then
        printf 'SKIPPED\t%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$name"
        continue
    fi

    destination="$delivered/$name"
    if [ -f "$destination" ]; then
        destination_id=$(message_id_from_file "$destination")
        if [ "$destination_id" = "$message_id" ]; then
            printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "${destination##*/}" >> "$index"
            printf 'RECORDED\t%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "${destination##*/}"
            continue
        fi

        stem=${name%.eml}
        number=1
        while [ -e "$delivered/$stem-$number.eml" ]; do
            number=$((number + 1))
        done
        destination="$delivered/$stem-$number.eml"
    fi

    temporary="$delivered/.replay-$$-$name"
    cp "$message" "$temporary"
    mv "$temporary" "$destination"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "${destination##*/}" >> "$index"
    printf 'RECOVERED\t%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "${destination##*/}"
done
REPLAY_EOF

printf '%s\n' '--- INSTALLED SCRIPT ---'
sed -n '1,240p' bin/replay
printf '%s\n' '--- SHELL SYNTAX ---'

commands.command:
set -eu
old_boot_id=$(cat /var/tmp/mail-spool-boot-id-before)
new_boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf '%s\n' '--- CHANGED BOOT IDENTITY ---'
printf 'old_boot_id=%s\nnew_boot_id=%s\n' "$old_boot_id" "$new_boot_id"
[ "$old_boot_id" != "$new_boot_id" ]
printf '%s\n' 'BOOT_ID_CHANGED=yes'
printf '%s\n' '--- POST-RESTART PLATFORM/SERVICES ---'
grep -E '^(PRETTY_NAME|VERSION_ID)=' /etc/os-release
uname -r
for service in networking chronyd vsock-agent sshd; do rc-service "$service" status; done
printf '%s\n' '--- POST-RESTART TASK RECOVERY ---'
cd /srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication
[ -x bin/replay ]
/bin/sh -n bin/replay
sha256sum delivered/* quarantine/* | sort > /tmp/post-replay-before
./bin/replay
sha256sum delivered/* quarantine/* | sort > /tmp/post-replay-after
diff -u /tmp/post-replay-before /tmp/post-replay-after
[ "$(find delivered -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.eml' | wc -l)" -eq 3 ]
[ "$(grep -il '^Subject:[[:space:]]*Notice[[:space:]]*$' delivered/*.eml | wc -l)" -eq 2 ]
awk 'NR > 1 { if (++seen[$1] > 1) exit 1 } END { if (NR != 4) exit 1 }' delivered/index.tsv
while read -r id file; do
  [ "$id" = message_id ] && continue
  [ -f "delivered/$file" ]
  grep -Fqx "Message-ID: $id" "delivered/$file"
  printf 'INDEX_OK\t%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$file"
done < delivered/index.tsv
cmp -s spool/bad.eml quarantine/bad.eml
grep -qi 'invalid Message-ID' quarantine/bad.eml.reason
printf '%s\n' '--- PERSISTED CONTENT CHECKSUMS ---'
sha256sum bin/replay spool/*.eml delivered/*.eml delivered/index.tsv quarantine/*
printf '%s\n' 'POST_RESTART_TASK_HEALTH=healthy'
rm -f /var/tmp/mail-spool-boot-id-before /var/tmp/mail-spool-reboot.log
